bookshelf-lib:
Bookshelf is a collection of code, frameworks, utilities, and other resources. Many mods utilize Bookshelf's code base to power their own mods. 

 Why use a library mod? 
 Library mods such as Bookshelf allow seemingly unrelated mods to share parts of the same code base. This reduces the amount of time and effort required to develop certain mods and features. The Library's code base is also tested in a wider range of circumstances and communities which can lead to less bugs and better performance in mods. 

 Features for Players 
 While this mod is primarily for mod authors, there are a few useful features for Players. 
 
 Debug commands like /bookshelf hand to get item IDs. 
 Many new datapack features like crafting recipes that damage items with durability rather than consuming them. 
 

 Features for Modders 
 
 Serialization for JSON/Network/NBT formats. 
 Utility Functions. 
 Regist

Stack Refill is a utility mod which automatically refills the itemstack in the player's hand if there is any of the same item in the inventory. It works for weapons in combat, tools used on blocks, stacks when placing blocks, eating food, using potions, tossing items on the ground, drinking milk buckets, when breaking a fishing rod and should work with all modded blocks. Thrown items like tridents and splash potions are refilled too. One of my personal favourite quality of life tweaks. Has to be installed on the server , as that's where the refilling happens. Players don't need it on their client. What gets refilled can be changed in the config, including a blacklist and whitelist for specific items. With /stackrefill every player can also turn it off for themselves.

Mining Speed Tooltips is a simple mod that adds an extra line of info text to all digging tools, such as pickaxes, axes, and shovels, showing the user the actual digging speed of the tool. biome-spawn-point: Biome Spawn Point allows specifying in which biome players should spawn when a new world is generated. This will work for vanilla biomes, as well as modded biomes. The spawn biomes can be picked on the Create World screen, in the World tab. Or for all new worlds via the 'spawnBiomes' config option, which also works on servers. Each biome can be given a weight, a higher weight is picked more often. Biomes of other dimensions can be used too. Pick a Nether, End or modded biome, and the world spawn will be set in that dimension. The spawn point is placed on land and a bit away from the biome's edge, so a beach that continues into the sea won't leave you in the water. The biome is picked using the world seed, so the same seed gives the same spawn point. The bonus chest world generation feature is compatible. If enabled, the bonus chest will be placed around the biome spawn position. This mod

Preferred Gamerules

A lightweight mod for customizing the default values of gamerules, i.e the values that are pre-selected when creating a new world.

Preferences are saved in .minecraft/config/preferred-gamerules.properties .
Each gamerule name is prefixed with gamerule. .

Example for MC 1.21.11 and onward:
 
gamerule.minecraft:fire damage=false
gamerule.minecraft:keep inventory=true
 

Example for older versions of Minecraft:
 
gamerule.fire damage=false
gamerule.keep inventory=true
 

Preferences can also be edited in-game via ModMenu , if installed. In this case, only values that are different from vanilla's default will be written to the config.

 Related Mods
 Gamerule Menu 
Makes the Gamerule menu accessible from singleplayer worlds

 Cloth Gamerules 
Cloth-Config replacement for the gamerules screen.

If you play with the Minecraft Dungeons Armors (MCDA), Minecraft Dungeons Weapons (MCDW) or Minecraft Dungeons Artifacts (MCDAR) mods, you already know that the items come with big walls of flavor text. This can take up a lot of screen real estate, and make it hard to read your enchantments and stats, especially by people who have larger GUI sizes.

This mod gives you full control over what tooltip information you want to see.

⚠️ Deprecation notice ⚠️

 As of Minecraft 1.21+, NeoForge now ships with Fabric's Mixin fork, eliminating the need for MixinBooster. 

---

 Mixin Booster

If you're a modder and wish to suffer less, well, here's this.

 What is this

This project replaces Sponge's (classic) Mixin which is used by (Neo)Forge with Fabric's version that has more features (like interface and constructor injections). 

Some mods may use this project to modify the game in a more compatible way.

 Usage

Modders just need to depend on this mod and have users install it, and it will replace the Mixin version at runtime by replacing its module source.

 Motivation

tacz-plus:
TACZ: Plus is an addon to TACZ (Timeless and Classics: Zero) which adds in more mechanics rather than new guns.
 
 (REQUIRES TIME STOP CLOCK AND TACZ)

The current mechanics are

-Leaning
This is a mechanic found in other games, and allows you to quickly peak around corners at an angle.
 
-Deadeye
Inspired by RDR2, deadeye allows you to slow down time, that means all mobs, all projectiles, player movement, is slowed down. This is indicated by the red eye and vignette when you hold down X (configurable).
 

-Focus
Focus zooms you in, makes you unable to move, and adds a vignette, it also stops your hands from shaking when zooming in making you more accurate. The default key is V.
 

There is also a showcase video if you want to see these mechanics in action.
Showcase Video

The modification adds a couple of types of blood particles. Now every damage will be accompanied by profuse bleeding!

anchor-optimizer:
Anchor Optimizer! 

This mod handles respawn anchor interactions client-side, so charging and blowing up anchors isn't held back by your ping.

---
 Information 

By default, the client waits for the server before it shows anything happening to an anchor. On high ping that means a delayed charge sound and an anchor that stays in place after you've already set it off.

This optimizer plays the charge sound the moment you add glowstone, and removes the anchor along with the glowstone around it as soon as you blow it up, instead of waiting for the server. The server still handles the real explosion and its damage.

---

 Server Opt-Out

The blending algorithm has been optimized to run faster by processing colors in two passes instead of all at once. Memory usage is more efficient thanks to better cache management and reusing objects instead of creating new ones constantly. The mod also uses pre-calculated values instead of doing the same math repeatedly, which speeds things up noticeably.

 Bug Fixes 

Fixed a bug where OptiFine compatibility wasn't working correctly due to incorrect code. Improved how the mod handles multiple threads to prevent crashes. Corrected issues with color blending that could cause visual glitches.

Ever encountered errors like "!!!!VS PHYS THREAD CRASH!!!!" or "Too many frames in queue, is game stage broken?" in single-player or multiplayer? These often cause game laggy, making it nearly impossible to place blocks or shipfy blocks.

 No worries! VS Safe and Sound is here to fix it. This mod catches potential crashes within the physics thread, including invalid forces/torques , unexpected constraint updates , and more.

Are you tired of standard Minecraft death mechanics? Maybe dying over and over again just to respawn is too easy, or playing Hardcore mode with one life is too difficult. preventing mobs that are not leashed from passing through fence gates. The mod

 Features
- Automatic merging of opaque full-cube block faces

notsohardcore:
Want to play a hardcore game with your friends, but get frustrated when any friend dies and can't play anymore?

 Not So Hardcore is here to solve this problem. With its lives that regenerate over time, you'll experience the fear of death like in hardcore mode, while still having the option to revive after a while.

 How it works

Your (default) maximum number of lives is 3.

Each time you die, you lose a life. But no stress, you can regain one life each 1 hour (by default) !

If a player loses all its lives, it will be switched to Spectator mode (like in vanilla hardcore) while waiting for a life to be regained.

You can see your remaining lives and time to regain one life in the Info Menu (pressing H key, by default).

The maximum number of lives and the regain time of a life are configurable.

 

For more info, checkout the Not So Hardcore Wiki !

 Warning : this mod modifies the norm

🪄Introduction
This mod is mainly made for modpacks, preventing players from easily killing bosses from afar.

 ⚙️Configuration
 The initial configuration file looks like:

 
{
 "show message": true,
 "message overlay": true,
 "distance config": {
 "minecraft:wither": 32.0,
 "minecraft:warden": 32.0
 }
}
 
To add the boss to the protection list, just simply add an entry to the "distance config" property.

The key of the entry represents the identifier (namespace:path) of the entity.

The value represents the "social distance" (float), within which players can attack the target.

totem-of-immortality:
This Forge mod adds a creative-only item that prevents a player's health from reaching 0 as long as it's in any inventory slot, without the totem disappearing or losing durability.

Players still can take damage, but will always be left with half a heart.

As this is obviously an item that enables cheating, it is not obtainable in survival mode, and has to be given through the creative mode inventory or via command.

Why?

Because one person in my friend group wants to play relaxed and without risk while the rest of us want to play a challenging mod pack. This way, we can all play on the same server.

Additionally, since the holder of the item can still take damage, it enables the person to practice combat and learn to survive without the risk of actually dying.

So if you have a beginner or a younger sibling or child that you'd like to teach Minecraft to, this might be the mod for you!

Technologies advance as fast as they shrink in size. Unfortunately, this isn't the case for redstone, as creating complex logic gates takes up a lot of space.

Until now.

With this mod, I've created a block for each existing logic gate (AND, OR, NOT, NOR, XOR, XNOR, NAND). Of course, this should also visually assist those less familiar with the redstone system but who have knowledge of electronic circuits.

This mod's entire purpose is to remove the warning that shows up in 25w20a and newer when you try to click text or a dialog button that has a click event that runs an operator command (or an invalid command or any other command that pops up a warning). It does this by simply changing the click event method to just run the command without checking the command. Also allows /say to be run from a click event, cool little side-effect.

 For Mod Developers:

parentalcontrols:
Parental Controls

Adds a server-side per-player time limit.

 

 Features

- Configurable time limit, kick message, etc.
- Tick-based timer (lag spikes won't count toward elapsed time)
- Reset at midnight

 Usage

The default time limit is 8 hours (480 minutes), but this along with some other settings can be changed in the config/parentalcontrols.json file. This can be reloaded on the fly with the /parental reload command. As a player, you can query your time remaining with the /parental remaining command. The time remaining is internally counted per-tick, assuming that the server runs at 20 ticks per second.

RotProxy

RotProxy is a client-side Fabric mod that routes Minecraft multiplayer connections through a configured SOCKS5, HTTP CONNECT or HTTPS proxy. The current release continues the same project on Minecraft Java 26.2 (rot-tools look, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25). Older Fabric builds remain available for 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 .

 Features

- SOCKS5, HTTP CONNECT and HTTPS (TLS to the proxy) tunnels
- Quick-access button on the Multiplayer screen ( RotProxy: Blocked / status)
- In-game settings: saved profiles, TEST, APPLY, DISABLE
- Fail-closed kill switch: multiplayer joins and server-list pings stay blocked until the proxy is healthy
- Heartbeat check every 15 seconds, with exit IP and probe latency
- Client-side only — do not install on a server

 Install (Minecraft 26.2)

1. Minecraft Java 26.2 , Java 25 , Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ 
2. Fabric API for 26.2
3. Put rotproxy-1.2.2+mc26.2

This small quality-of-life mod makes experience absorption nearly instant while still preserving part of the XP orb animation. InstantXP only changes how quickly orbs are collected: vanilla XP amounts, Mending behavior and orb values remain unchanged, and the mod does not create XP or manually discard orbs.

Give me a ⭐ on GitHub 💝

 Installation

Singleplayer works because Minecraft runs an integrated server inside the client. The XP logic still runs server-side, just within your local game.

For multiplayer, install InstantXP on the server. Players do not need to install the mod on their clients. Installing the mod only on the client will not affect XP behavior on a dedicated server, since XP pickup is handled entirely by the server.

 Join the Fluxer server for community & mod support 

 QnA

- Why does it cap out at 15?
 - There are a few caps set on this option; it is set to 15, as that's the maximum amount with minimal tinkering. It will hopefully be increased in the future.

- Is there a performace hit?
 - Almost certainly. While I haven't tested the exact value, keep in mind that you are adding multiple blocks' worth of particles for every increase.

 - If they use the vanilla Weather Effect Radius setting, then yes.

English Description

 Chat Upgrade is a Fabric mod that enhances Minecraft chat with rich media rendering.

- Inline media preview : Recognizes [[ChatUpgrade,url=…]] payloads and replaces links with placeholders. Renders images, audio players, and video players directly inside the chat message area.
- Inline emojis : Uses [:token] syntax (e.g. [:bilibili tv gif-2] ) and a mapping from owo.json to display square emoji images.
- Flexible upload modes :
 - Auto mode (default) : If the server supports media uploads, files go directly to the server. Otherwise, uses third‑party hosting (Litterbox, ~1h expiry).
 - Server mode / Third‑party mode : Forced routing via commands or config.

slowcraft:
Slowcraft

 Slowcraft is a library mod for modpack, datapack and mod authors to create progressive crafting items called SlowTools. 

Inspired by the Knitting system in Better Than Wolves and the Polishing system in Create.

 

 SlowTools

SlowTools are intermediary crafting items, intended to be time-consuming crafts. The player holds right-click to work on it while its durability bar shows the current progress.

Progress is saved when the player stops, so a long craft can be completed a little at a time. Once the bar finishes, the SlowTool is consumed and its outputs are given to the player.

 A real life example could include things like knitting, weaving, or whittling. 

 

 Requirements

- Fabric API
- (Optional) JEI

Slowcraft is a library mod. Installing it by itself does not add anything; mods, modpacks, and datapacks use it to create their own SlowTools.

 Documentation

- Slowc

Chaos Drop completely randomizes every drop in the game — breaking blocks and killing mobs no longer gives their normal loot. Instead, each source is permanently assigned a random result: either a random item drop or a random mob spawn, in a random quantity. Half of all assignments drop items, the other half spawn mobs — so yes, breaking dirt might spawn 12 Wardens, and killing a Warden might drop a single potato.
The assignments are saved to your world, so they stay consistent until you decide to reset them. No tool requirement either — every block drops something regardless of what you break it with.

Commands

/chaosreset — Wipes and fully re-randomizes all drop assignments. (OP only)
/chaosmultiplier — Sets the maximum possible quantity for drops and spawns. For example, setting it to 50 means any given drop could be anywhere from 1 to 50. Run /chaosreset after to apply the new range

Eggcat Mod

The Eggcat Mod is a simple Minecraft mod that adds a new decorative block to the game: the Eggcat. This block serves as
a light source that can be turned on and off by clicking it.

 Getting Started

 Prerequisites

To use the Eggcat Mod, you will need the following:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

 Installing

1. Download and install Fabric Loader following the instructions on the Fabric website.
2. Download the Eggcat Mod JAR file from the releases page.
3. Move the JAR file to the mods folder in your Minecraft installation directory.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

 Crafting the Eggcat Block

Once you have installed the mod, you can find the Eggcat block in the creative inventory or craft it in a crafting table
like the pattern specified below:

 
 O 
 O i O 
 O O O 
 
 O = Egg
 i = Redstone Torch
 

To turn the light on or off, simply right-click the block.

- Can't damage any player
- Can't take damage from a player

 Installation
Drop the jar file into your server's/client's mod folder.
 Note: Clients don't need to install the mod to join a server with this mod

- Vanilla-style progression

This data pack makes items with durability unbreakable, and removes any damage done to them previously.

 ⚠ Do not use this data pack if you wish to have items with durability stored somewhere, as it will modify them if it triggers ⚠ 

It does this by adding an advancement triggered by a player's inventory changing, calling a function to modify items in the inventory to make them unbreakable (with the tooltip hidden).
The datapack specifically checks for already unbreakable items, and does not modify them. This means that items with the "unbreakable" component shown in the tooltip will not lose the tooltip.

The item modification currently does not trigger when changing other inventories (such as chests), but would still modify open ones if triggered.

diagonal-perfect-rails-3d:
🎉Thank you for 50k downloads! 🎉
---
 The Design Philosophy

 

 Curved rails do not match the actual movement

In Minecraft, minecarts run 45 degrees straight on continuous curved rails. However, the vanilla texture produces a twisty pattern for the continuous curved rails. This pack fixed that by making the curved rails diagonal-perfect. Now the rails fit the motion of minecarts!

 

 Reinforced ramp rails

The vanilla models of the ramp rails look fragile since they lack support. This pack fixed that by adding wooden frames under the ramp rails.

 

 Redesigned vanilla rails

The powered rail is crafted from gold instead of iron, so the rail has a pure gold texture. 
The activator rail, when powered, will make the minecart wobble, so the model matches that by having two bumps on the rail.

 

 Shiny rails

With LabPBR-supported shaders, the rails look more realistic.

 Create Mod Sup

mtrseoul-metro-trains:
Introduction

This resource pack adds Seoul Metro Trains (Woojin Heavy Industries) for Minecraft Transit Railway Mod.

This pack requires Minecraft Transit Railway Mod (MTR3, MTR4) and Nemo's Transit Expansion for MTR3 version (NTE)

 Terms & infos

This RP can be applied manually in the 'Resource Packs' page in the same way that other RPs are applied after Installing Required Mods and Addons.

Before using, please set the JVM arguments to 6GB or higher. It may take some time to load this RP.

MTR3 and MTR4 use different versions, and for MTR3, it is recommended to make appropriate number of the cars (information could be found in Spreadsheet - could be found at wiki link)

Trains must be setted in even numbers except for free length train (MTR3)

Recommended settings for MTR4: Front cab - carriage - panto - Back cab

 Contents

 Seoul Metro Woojin Trains (Line 4, 5, 7, 8)

smooth-wood-products:
I have often seen fences retextured to with the stripped log textures in order to give them a smoother appearance and give a more natural look to custom trees. After all, why would they be made of several horizontal planks anyways ? Since I didn't like the idea of changing plank products to look like logs (which also has a separate color scheme), I made a resource pack to give some wooden objects a smoother , more versatile appearance while staying faithful to the color and look of the planks texture using slightly modified versions of the original textures.

Modifies the appearance of Wooden Fences, Fence Gates, Wooden Buttons, Tripwire Hooks, and Armor Stands.

This pack is compatible with my Consistent Fence Items resource pack, providing consistent item models for fences. To use both, have this pack selected BELOW the Consistent Fence Items pack.

Too smooth for you? Check out my Bet

mtr4-cp-class-2240:
Overview
 
The CP Class 2240 is an electric multiple unit (EMU) operated by Comboios de Portugal (CP) for regional and suburban services. Each unit consists of three cars: two driving trailers at the ends and one power car in the middle that houses the traction motors.

These trains were assembled between 2003 and 2005 by Alstom, using refurbished body shells from older Sorefame-built units (Classes 2100, 2150, and 2200), helping reduce costs and preserve classic rolling stock. The bogies were newly built with Alstom traction motors, and the units run on the Iberian gauge (1668 mm).

They can operate in multiple unit configurations of up to three sets, allowing for a total of nine passenger cars in service. Their modernized interiors, updated fronts, and improved systems make them a common sight on Portuguese regional routes.

-The texture pack that makes the new the old. Heavily inspired by Golden Days by PoeticRainbow and Old Minecraft. This texture pack changes blocks, mobs, items, GUI, sounds, and much more to look like older versions of Minecraft.

Helpful Info
-It's recommended to use Optifine or Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features for the mobs changed to work properly .
-Enable programmer art first it is needed for more authentic experience.
-This texture pack was first made privately for me to try to enjoy modern Minecraft more but I decided to tweak it and publish it

Disclaimer
-This texture pack is still unfinished as there are some newer mobs that still need to be changed
-There may be some items and blocks I missed
-Feedback is greatly appreciated since I am new at texture packing and I am willing to update this pack and in the future work on other projects.

resounding-modern-warfare-assets:
You’ve read the tagline, so here’s what you need to know: These sounds were edited by me, and are designed for hardcore/survival gameplay. The way sounds work in VMW means I can’t add variations or use a shot/auto/tailfire system like Triple-A FPS games, so each individual shot has an echo attached. This means that if you have a lot of people shooting at the same time it’s going to sound very loud, and a bit overkill.

This pack will work with base VMW versions if you change the "mwc" folder's name to "mw", and should work with Paneedah’s versions, be that PMW or MWC, but you will miss out on some features : For those, you’ll have to use Resounding Modern Warfare, which as a bonus, will give you some more guns to play with. Resounding Modern Warfare is designed to change as little of the functionality of the mod as possible, with the first priority being the addition of new sound events,

CC:Tweaked Cyrillic Font (Win1251)

This resource pack replaces the default CC:Tweaked font with a Windows-1251 compatible Cyrillic font .

This project can help you actualy TYPE (INPUT) cyrillic characters, rather than just output them to the console.

 ⌨️ How to enable typing
The resource pack only changes how text looks . To be able to type in Cyrillic, you need to install a driver script.

Run this command on your ingame computer(or turtle):
 
pastebin get SE2bgZCy /startup/cyrillic.lua
 

After downloading, reboot the computer .

 ⚙️ Configuration
The script runs in the background automatically. To change the keyboard layout, edit the first line of /startup/cyrillic.lua :
- LOCALE = 'RU' (Russian - Default)
- LOCALE = 'UA' (Ukrainian)
- LOCALE = 'BY' (Belarusian)

Player View Distance Controller (PVDC) is a lightweight yet powerful Paper plugin that gives full control over view distance. It boosts performance and offers extensive customisation, including permissions, automatic performance modes, AFK handling, and more. With support for LuckPerms, GeyserMC and PlaceholderAPI, it integrates smoothly into any server.

 Visit the docs for information on how to use this plugin .

 

 Key Features 
- Per-player control : Each player has their own max view distance, which can be set and saved individually by themselves or by another player.
- Global control : Easily set the max view distance of all online players.
- MSPT‑based dynamic mode : Automatically reduce view distance when MSPT increases, helping to stabilise performance.

safe-zones: SafeZone is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that lets you create rectangular protected zones where PvP, mob damage, and block breaking are disabled. Perfect for spawn areas, shops, or any location you want to keep safe. Players can use /safezone set to define a zone centered on their current position, and /safezone remove to delete it. Zones are stored in memory and enforced via event listeners. No external dependencies, no bloat—just clean protection logic. Ideal for small servers, community hubs, or mythic realms that need a touch of order. Future updates will include config persistence, visual indicators, and permission support. Built for Spigot 1.13+ and designed to be fast, simple, and effective.
